items.description: About DeleteMe : DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud. Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection. DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce. DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy. Job Title: Director, Growth Job Summary: Attacker Doesn't Sleep. Neither Should Our GTM Stack. DeleteMe helps people and companies delete the personal data that fuels phishing, doxxing, and AI-powered social engineering attacks. We're the category leader in personal data removal — and we're now defining the next category: Human Attack Surface Management (HASM). We move fast, ship faster, and think in systems, not tickets. We're looking for a Director of Growth who doesn't just manage marketing campaigns but a AI-native growth machine. If "growth hacking” to you means Zapier and a few HubSpot workflows, this isn't your role. If it means dynamic campaigns, agentic pipelines, LLM-orchestrated lead scoring, and infrastructure that gets smarter every week without a headcount increase, keep reading. Responsibilities: -You'll sit at the intersection of marketing, sales, RevOps, and data — but you'll operate like a growth hacker, not a coordinator. -Build the AI-native GTM stack: Design and own the systems architecture connecting our CRM, marketing automation, enrichment, intent data, and outbound motion — with AI agents doing the work humans used to do manually. -Automate the funnel, end to end: From lead scoring and routing to personalization at scale, you'll build pipelines that use LLMs and agentic workflows to make every touch smarter than the last. -Instrument everything: Attribution, pipeline velocity, campaign performance — you'll build the dashboards and data models that let leadership make real-time decisions, not monthly ones. -Prototype relentlessly: You'll stand up scrappy internal tools and agents in days, not quarters — proving value fast, then hardening what works. -Partner cross-functionally: You'll work directly with marketing leadership (including our CMO) on campaigns like our co-branded research initiatives with 451 Research/S&P Global, translating category-defining content strategy into scalable, systemized execution. -Build the team: You'll start as a builder and grow into a leader — hiring and mentoring GTM engineers who share your obsession with automation and speed. Experience: -You're AI-first, not AI-curious: You've built real workflows with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and automation tooling — not just used ChatGPT to write emails. You have opinions about prompt architecture, context windows, and where agents fail. -You code: Python, SQL, and API-level fluency are table stakes. You're comfortable in a CRM's data model and in a Jupyter notebook in the same afternoon. -You've lived in the GTM stack: Salesforce or HubSpot, Clay, Outreach/Salesloft, 6sense/ZoomInfo, Segment — you know how these systems actually talk to each other (and where they lie to each other). -You think like a founder: You default to building over buying, shipping over planning, and you measure your own impact in pipeline and velocity, not activity. -You've done this before: 5+ years in GTM/RevOps/marketing engineering, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or security company, with real ownership of systems and outcomes. -You're allergic to bureaucracy: You'd rather build the automation than write the ticket asking someone else to. -Bonus: experience in security, privacy, or risk categories — you understand urgency-driven buyers and how to build pipeline around a category the market is still learning to name. What We Offer: Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, location, employment status, and other factors. Comprehensive health benefits - Medical, Vision, Dental 401k retirement plan Paid Parental Leave 20 days of Paid Time Off 11 Company-Paid Holidays Birthday Off Work From Home Stipend Cell Phone Reimbursement Fitness Membership Reimbursement Child Care Reimbursement DeleteMe Gold Membership Discounted DM Plans for Friends and Family Compensation Additional Information

items.description: Job Description: Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data-driven AI insights, evidence-based resources, and comprehensive platform – including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, health information management, and more – Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value-based care at scale. To learn more, visit . Job Summary: The Manager of Global Operations has an overall responsibility for ensuring their required tasks are performed in a consistent, timely, and highly professional manner. The Manager of Global Operations ensures objectives, principles, values, mission and foundation are represented with Global partners. The position also supports global operational activities that are focused on the achievement of company-wide operational goals. The Manager of Global Operations will do so with an emphasis on global partner engagement, relationship development, work quality, operational efficiency, long and short-term planning, customer-oriented thinking and P&L profitability. The Manager of Global Operations will work closely with the Director of Provider Global Operations, the Director of Automation and Globalization and other leaders to implement processes that will ensure exemplary member experience and market-leading performance quality. Essential Job Functions: Global Account Management Support Support Sales and Customer Service activities directed at new Clients/Prospects with RFP responses and internal/external meetings Support the identification and transition of existing Onshore clients to Global clients Support daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly Client Review calls with feedback and direction for Global Partners Global Operational Support Respond to and resolve escalated Client/Requester issues Support Inventory Management initiatives Partner with Director Provider Global Ops to create and manage goals relating to Productivity and Quality for Global Partners Quality Control – Perform Analysis and Administer Actions Plans and Training. Queue Management – Perform Analysis and Administer Corrective Actions/Training Provide Training Support to Global Partners both in country and virtually Analysis of endangered accounts and creation of action plans to address problems/account feedback Chase Activities Monitor, manage and establish new additions Communicate effectively to all CHASE team members Complete Chase Activities ahead of Deadlines. Ensure Global Partners have adequate Credentials to match inventory and production plans. If not adequate, work to resolve with client, CS, Ops teams Support Technical events that occur. Manage and Support SOP Documentation for all Global Accounts Organizational Leadership Model Sharecare ’s core values of Family, Servant Leadership, Giving Back, Compassion, Respect, Accountability and Innovation to Global Partners Operate within the Global Team to achieve goals and objectives quickly, efficiently and profitably Possess strong communication and training skills to deliver feedback and direction on how to improve Global operations Communicate essential updates to internal and external stakeholders Collect and assess documentation required to successfully transition regional operations activities to global according to deadlines set forth by Director of Provider Global Operations Measure global performance to objectives established by Director of Provider Global Operations Financial Management Continually seek new opportunities to advance Sharecare ’s transition plan and achieve expected transition milestones and targets Assist Global Partner in meeting their KPI’s for Productivity and Quality to lower overall Sharecare costs Customer Service Assist in building and strengthening global partnerships Coordinate with Operations and Client Success Manager(s) to onboard new clients and transition exiting clients to global production Specific Skills/Attributes: A thorough understanding of role requirements, including policies, procedures and processes, to include how individual work impacts the organization and its strategic and financial goals; and how tasks and projects affect the integrity of the organization’s data and information Commitment to discuss questions and recommendations about global processes and any observed variations in performing tasks to ensure a standardized approach to work and services provided Participation in education as required for corporate compliance and role-specific functions and tasks Qualifications: Minimum of 7-10 years proven success in manager or director level role Extremely team oriented High proficiency in Microsoft suite of products Outlook, Word, Powerpoint and Excel including development of pivot tables to analyze data Effectively utilizes Power BI reports to manage Global partners Ability to work well in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment while prioritizing and meeting deadlines Superior communication skills Outstanding customer service with strong negotiation skills Detail oriented, with strong analytical skills and effective problem-solving skills Ability to handle confidential materials and information in a professional manner Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law. items.description: About Wellspring Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Evolve, Astria, Sophia & Flintbox—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine of top-of-funnel growth. You will own the full prospecting motion — from identifying and sourcing target contacts to feeding them into multi-channel outbound campaigns, nurturing prospects through early-stage conversations, and converting engagement into qualified pipeline. You will also serve as the first human touch for inbound inquiries, respond quickly to capture intent, and work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to book, run, and advance discovery calls. Your output is measured in Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and pipeline dollars delivered. Core Responsibilities As aSolutionsConsultant, you are the technical and strategic partner to our enterprise account executives across Europe. You own the "whythis mattersto you " of every deal — translating a customer's portfolio and innovation challenges into a compelling, credible vision of what Wellspring makes possible, and demonstrating it in a way that moves executive stakeholders to act. You will spend your time researching accounts deeply, running discovery with senior stakeholders, and building and delivering tailored demonstrations that tell a story rather than list capabilities.You'llwork shoulder-to-shoulder with sales, product, and services to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals inside some of the largest and most sophisticated enterprises in the world. This is a role for someone who thinks of pre-sales as a craft: part strategist, part storyteller, part domain expert. What you'll do Research accountslikean analyst.Before a single conversation, build a genuine understanding of the customer's business — their portfolio strategy, product pipeline, organizational structure, public commitments, and the pressures driving their industry. Turn that research into a hypothesis about where Wellspring creates value. Lead consultative discovery.Run discovery sessions with large, cross-functional groups and senior stakeholders. Ask the questions that surface the real problem beneath the statedone, andearn the right to be seen as an advisor rather than a vendor. Sell through storytelling.Frame every demonstration as a narrative the customer sees themselves in — anchored to their strategic priorities, their language, and their people. Make the abstract concrete and the complex simple. Build tailored demos.Design and construct bespoke demonstrations that reflect the specific customer, use case, and stakeholders — not a generic sandbox. Bring account research directly into the demo environment so what the customer sees feels built for them, because it was. Present to executives.Command a room of senior decision-makers — VPs and C-level in R&D, innovation, engineering, and IT — with credibility, clarity, and presence. Handlehard questionsin real time. Own the technical win.Lead technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and responses to RFPs/RFIs. Address security, integration, and architecture questions in partnership with product and services. Be a two-way conduit.Bring the voice of the customer back to product and go-to-marketteams, andhelp sharpen how Wellspring positions itself in the strategic portfolio management category. Travel to where the deals are.Roughly 25%travel across Europe (and occasionally beyond) for key customer meetings, workshops, and events. What you'll bring Enterprise pre-sales / solutions consulting experienceselling complex B2B SaaS to large enterprises, ideally with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. A genuine talent for storytelling and demonstration— you can take a complex platform and make it land as a clear, resonant narrative for a specific audience. Strong consultative discovery skills—you'recomfortable leading conversations with large groups and senior executives, and you listen at least as well as you present. Rigorous account research habits— you do the homework, and itshows inhow tailored and credible your engagements are. Executive presence and communication—you'repersuasive, composed, and clear in front of the most senior people in acustomer'sorganization. Comfort with technical depth— you can speak credibly about integrations, data, architecture, and security, and know when to bring in specialists. Awareness of AI and agentic architecture— youdon'tneed to be an expert, but you understand that this is where enterprise software is heading, andyou'recomfortable holding a credible conversation to that end with both technical and business stakeholders. A working understanding of API-driven workflows— how data moves from systems of record through integrations to downstream end users. Fluent English;additionalEuropean languages are a strong advantage given the customer base. Nice to have Experience inthestrategicportfolio management, innovation management, R&D management, or PPMspace is a real plus — but it isnotrequired. Ifyou'vebuilt deepenterprise SaaS solution-selling experience in an adjacent complex domain,we'llhelp youlearnthe category. Familiarity with one or more of our core verticals:chemical, consumer goods, aerospace & defense, or pharmaceutical. A background that blends technical and commercial fluency — consulting, product, ora technicaldiscipline paired with customer-facing work. Experience in Demo2Win or Value Based Sellingmethodolgies. Location & logistics Remote, based anywhere in Western Europewith reasonable access to an international airport. ~25% travelexpected for customer meetings, workshops, and events. You'llwork across time zones with a distributed European team and colleagues in North America. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies,…
items.description: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. About The Role Lyra Health’s Clinical Strategy team is seeking a seasoned Senior Operations Lead for a high-impact, 6-month contract engagement focused on driving our Joint Commission (TJC) Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) accreditation readiness. This role sits at the intersection of clinical strategy, regulatory execution, and cross-functional project management. Acting as the primary project lead, you will bridge the gap between Clinical Strategy, Clinical Operations, and key cross-functional teams to drive our accreditation roadmap. This role is ideal for a senior healthcare project manager who excels at translating complex regulatory mandates or compliance standards into actionable project plans. While familiarity with Joint Commission standards is preferred, we are primarily seeking an exceptional operational lead who can quickly get up to speed on TJC requirements, partner with clinical domain experts, and drive execution. You are a self-directed player-coach who is comfortable getting "in the weeds" with workstream leads to build compliance documentation while also zooming out to present a 30,000-foot risk assessment to leadership. What You’ll Do (6-Month Scope) As a senior contractor, you will hit the ground running and lead the execution of our TJC survey readiness roadmap: Roadmap & Work Plan Ownership: Refine, maintain, and drive the master Project Work Plan for TJC Behavioral Health and Telehealth accreditation readiness, establishing clear workstream milestones across clinical and operational teams. Gap Analysis & Risk Mitigation: Continuously identify gaps, compliance risks, and cross-functional dependencies; proactively update the roadmap and implement risk mitigation strategies. Workstream Facilitation: Partner directly with workstream leads to deep-dive into specific TJC standards. Develop supporting materials and process documentation as needed. Mock Survey & Readiness Execution: Organize and project manage internal mock audits, tracer activities, and readiness drills to ensure operational teams are fully prepared for survey execution. Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish clear communication cadences across stakeholders (live working groups, asynchronous updates, and project dashboards) to drive cross-functional accountability. Executive Visibility: Develop concise, data-driven written updates for senior leadership to highlight progress, key milestones, and critical risks. Requirements: 10+ years of healthcare project management, healthcare operations, or management consulting experience, preferably within high-growth health tech or clinical environments Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional regulatory, compliance, or accreditation readiness initiatives from gap analysis through execution Exceptional strategic and project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership without direct authority Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to distill complex clinical insights and regulatory requirements into actionable executive summaries A highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can create structure out of ambiguity Deep passion for expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care Preferred Qualifications: Direct experience or familiarity with the accreditation process (e.g., The Joint Commission, CARF, NCQA, or other), specifically within Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) or virtual/telehealth models Compensation Additional Information "We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice . Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. We may also collect information about your race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation, which is considered sensitive personal information under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and special category data under the UK and EU GDPR. Providing this information is optional and completely voluntary, and if you provide it you consent to Lyra processing it for the purposes as described at the point of collection, for example for diversity and inclusion initiatives. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form . This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems. These rights may be subject to legal limitations. To exercise your data privacy rights outside of the United States, please contact globaldpo@lyrahealth.com . For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice ."

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Netherlands URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/careers ✨ Where do we hire from? Find out if we're hiring in your location from hiring at TestGorilla Hi there, I'm Mehak , interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team. About the role As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales. Responsibilities In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to: Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture. Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets. Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots. Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor. Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions. Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language. Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment. Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS. We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far. Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager. Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite. Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly. Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use. Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift. We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have: Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution. Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM. Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget. Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels. Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being Interested? At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone! When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data. We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. Concerned about test anxiety? We've got you covered. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-senior-demand-generation-manager

items.description: We are looking for a product-minded Applied Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer to help build, ship, and scale ML-powered products that directly improve how our customers make decisions, operate their businesses, and serve their own users. This is not a research-only role, nor is it a service-oriented internal analytics position. We want someone who has taken machine learning from problem definition through experimentation, production deployment, measurement, iteration, and long-term ownership. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, measurable, scalable, and valuable inside a real product. Whether your background leans heavily toward Data Engineering/ML Ops or Applied Data Science, you have a strong bias toward shipping and an interest in bridging both worlds to bring AI to life. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Engineering & AI Enablement End-to-End ML Ownership: Drive the development of machine learning capabilities (forecasting, recommendation, ranking, optimization, or decision intelligence) powering customer-facing SaaS products. Pipeline & Model Development: Design reliable data and feature pipelines alongside models from discovery through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Product Integration: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to embed ML directly into product workflows, user experiences, and decision-making tools. Pragmatic Prototyping: Move quickly from prototype to production while balancing accuracy, interpretability, latency, maintainability, and business impact. Ecosystem Ownership & Strategy Evaluation & Experimentation: Define offline and online evaluation strategies, including model quality, drift, and reliability. Design A/B tests and causal measurement frameworks to prove ML features improve customer outcomes. Data Health & Feedback Loops: Collaborate with Data teams to ensure models are supported by high-quality features, while building feedback loops so product experiences improve over time. Platform & MLOps Support: Help manage and optimize cloud data infrastructure, ensuring trustworthy insights and proactively managing data health before it impacts users. Product & Technical Direction Strategic Judgment: Bring strong judgment around when to use traditional ML, statistical modeling, LLMs, heuristics, or simpler product logic. Make practical trade-offs across model complexity and customer impact. Roadmap Influence: Clearly communicate what ML can and cannot solve to influence roadmap decisions, helping identify where machine learning can create true product differentiation. Mentorship: Guide and mentor other data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and cross-functional partners in applied ML best practices. WHO YOU ARE: The Proven Builder: You have shipped ML into real products. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous product problem, figuring out if ML is the right solution, building it, and measuring whether it worked. Product-First Architect: You care about product impact as much as model performance. You know that a model with slightly lower accuracy but higher trust, faster inference, better explainability, and stronger user adoption is the better product decision. A Multi-Disciplinary Executioner: You understand that a model is only as good as the pipeline feeding it. You prioritize usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: Experience: 3+ years (ideally 5+) of professional experience in applied data science, machine learning, or ML engineering, including hands-on experience building and shipping models into production products. Experience with SaaS products is highly valued. Technical Core: Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with applied ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow). Solid SQL expertise is required. ML & Modeling Depth: Strong understanding of supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation systems, optimization, or statistical modeling. Experience with real-world, imperfect product datasets is essential. Ops & Orchestration: Familiarity with MLOps concepts (model versioning, feature pipelines, orchestration via Airflow/dbt/Dagster, monitoring, drift detection) and modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks). Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience operating within cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to product, engineering, and non-technical business stakeholders. BONUS POINTS FOR: Experience with decision intelligence, forecasting, customer behavior modeling, workforce/route optimization, or operational intelligence products. Experience with LLMs, GenAI, or agentic workflows applied to real product use cases. Prior experience acting as a Senior or Lead scientist responsible for guiding technical direction. WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US: • We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers • We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses • We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust • Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges • Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us! LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT: • Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority. A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE: • We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment. • Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming. • We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community. • Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other. RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED: • Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including health and dental and 401k with company match AND BEYOND... • Find your perfect work/life balance with our Flexible Time Off policy or generous PTO plan (role dependent) and paid holidays • Up to 4 weeks paid bonding leave • Tuition reimbursement • Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more! • 24/7 access to virtual medical care with Teladoc • Quarterly awards based on peer nominations • Regional discounts and perks • Opportunities to participate in charitable events and give back to the community GROW WITH US: • We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth • Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense! • Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM! • 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz! • WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine • Named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!) We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status: Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At WorkWave, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you feel like you could make a great impact in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

This is a practical, results-driven role focused on developing AI-powered automations and MVP solutions that streamline operations and enhance program visibility. In this role, the Consultant will partner with Project Managers, Operations, and Clinical teams to turn real operational challenges into effective, user-friendly tools built on Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and large language models. Note that compliance, pharmacovigilance, DPIA, and patient data handling fall outside the scope of this role — those responsibilities sit entirely with the client's internal teams. What You'll Be Doing The Consultant will own the end-to-end delivery of focused, high-value MVPs and automations across 2–3-week sprints, with structured demos and knowledge transfer at each cycle. The engagement will span across 6-8 weeks, and full-time work may be available after this period. Work will span: Building a Trust Engagement Database leveraging tools such as Notion, SharePoint, or equivalent platforms. Developing Power Automate workflows and Copilot Agent assets — covering prompt libraries, lightweight agent frameworks, automated SLA reminders, email and Teams-based triggers, tracking dashboards, and recurring or on-demand reporting. Prototyping LLM-assisted Adverse Event (AE) triage workflows (non-PHI), encompassing classification and summarization logic, intelligent routing, and retrieval from approved content sources. Wrapping up solutions as reusable, well-documented components: data models, deployment runbooks, and step-by-step how-to guides. Working hand-in-hand with Project Managers and Operations to make sure every solution lands well and can scale. Contributing to the client's AI-driven Digital Transformation initiatives. What We're Looking For Proven track record delivering production-ready automations within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, Power BI). Hands-on experience working with LLM-based tools, prompts, or agent frameworks (Azure OpenAI, Copilot, Claude, or similar). Strong command of data modeling using Notion, Excel, CSV, and Microsoft Graph. History of shipping MVPs on tight, sprint-based timelines. Comfortable working in a contract/consultancy capacity. You must be available for 6 to 8 weeks of work, with the potential of staying on as a full-time staff member afterward. Background in pharma or healthcare — particularly familiarity with industry terminology — is a significant plus. Nice to Have Experience integrating HubSpot or Microsoft Graph into existing workflows. Knowledge of evaluation frameworks for classification and summarization tasks. A portfolio of reusable internal tooling built for external clients. Working Style & Values Able to navigate non-PHI environments confidently and responsibly. Highly organized with a sharp ability to prioritize under pressure. Thrives in dynamic, fast-moving settings. Our client is a values-driven organization in the healthcare space, guided by the principles of caring, candor, and high performance. They are seeking someone who welcomes feedback, adapts their approach based on team input, and brings both conviction and humility to collaborative problem-solving. if this sounds right for you, use the form below to apply! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: United Audit Systems, Inc. ( UASI ), a rapidly growing healthcare consulting firm, is seeking a Resource Optimization Specialist to join our Operations team. UASI is an innovative healthcare consulting firm serving nationally recognized leaders in healthcare, and we are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical professional to help ensure our client-facing teams are deployed efficiently, productively, and profitably across all client engagements. The primary purpose of this position is to support capacity forecasting, real-time resource utilization, and staffing alignment in partnership with our Service Line Managers, HR/Recruiting, and the Resource Optimization Manager. Key Responsibilities: Maintain real-time visibility of available staff, client assignments, and capacity across service lines Forecast resource needs based on volume trends, renewals, new clients, scheduled PTO, turnover, and client cycles Align resources to clients based on skill set, performance history, certification, access, and availability Monitor utilization and productivity KPIs — including overtime as a percentage of total labor hours — to support margin protection targets Maintain resource and skills data in QuickBase in accordance with the standardized processes Contribute to a weekly workforce digest and monthly workforce alignment report, and participate in weekly workforce operations reviews Identify staffing risks and coverage gaps proactively, and collaborate with Client Success Managers and Staffing Success Managers on improvement plans Support development of a cross-service-line “flex pool” of resources eligible for deployment across engagements Requirements for the position include: 2+ years of healthcare operations, resource planning, resource management, or related experience Analytical skills, including resource forecasting and performance modeling Proficiency in QuickBase or similar resource/planning tools Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to assess risk and drive proactive, data-informed decision-making Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including 365, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Preferred qualifications: Experience with Coding, CDI, or revenue cycle operations Familiarity with healthcare staffing models and terminology Experience building dashboards or reports (Power BI a plus) UASI provides a supportive environment that encourages professional development and enables each employee to achieve their individual goals. items.description: Addepto is a leading AI consulting () and data engineering () company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide. As part of KMS Technology, a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilities—enabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. As a Lead Data Scientist / AI Engineer / Tech Lead , you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join: AI optimization engine for airport operation management. This project involves creating an AI-driven optimization engine to streamline airport operations, using real-time data from sources like radar, air traffic, and passenger information. AI recommendation engine for the leading innovation company. This project involves creation of AWS-powered solutions to provide domain-specific recommendations by employing sophisticated LLMs. 🚀 Your main responsibilities: Lead the development, implementation, and validation of Machine Learning solutions, ensuring alignment with project objectives. Lead the design of AI solution architectures that meet complex business goals and drive innovation. Research, test and select the best tools and technologies as well as AI solutions to meet the business requirements. Lead and mentor cross-functional teams, encouraging collaboration and helping everyone grow their skills. Understand clients' needs and translate business problems into data science problems. Architect and oversee the implementation of data pipelines and workflows, setting standards for data quality and security. Coordinate with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams to strategize and oversee the building of AI applications.. Present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely to stakeholders. Prioritize, and control tasks within an Agile/Scrum framework, ensuring timely delivery. Requirements 🎯 What you’ll need to succeed in this role: 6+ years of commercial experience in designing and implementing scalable AI solutions (Machine Learning, Predictive Modeling, Optimization, NLP, LLM, Computer Vision, GenAI). Experience in leading end-to-end Machine Learning projects and managing cross-functional teams . Proficiency in developing ML algorithms from scratch to production deployment. Strong programming skills in Python: writing clean code, OOP design, extensive knowledge of ML libraries (Scikit-Learn, PyTorch/Tensorflow). Proven expertise in deploying solutions in cloud environments (preferably AWS and/or Azure ). Knowledge in applying LLMs (semantic search, prompt engineering, multimodal embeddings, RAG). High proficiency in English (C1 level). Excellent communication skills and consulting experience with direct interaction with clients. Working experience in SQL and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks). Good knowledge of CI / CD principles (GitHub and GitHub Actions). Familiarity with MLOps practices, Kubernetes and Docker. Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. Experience with Big Data technologies like Spark, Hadoop, and Kafka is a plus. 🎁 Discover our perks & benefits: Work in a supportive team of passionate enthusiasts of AI & Big Data. Engage with top-tier global enterprises and cutting-edge startups on international projects. Enjoy flexible work arrangements, allowing you to work remotely or from modern offices and coworking spaces. Accelerate your professional growth through career development paths, knowledge-sharing initiatives, language classes, and sponsored training and conferences . Benefit from partnerships with Databricks and Anthropic , which provide access to industry-leading training materials and certification programs. Participate in team-building events and utilize the integration budget . Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Analytics & Finance Manager, International
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role As a Analytics & Finance Manager, International at Grüns , you will apply strategic thinking and deep quantitative expertise to own and scale analytics for our international business. You’ll partner closely with senior international leaders to evaluate performance, surface opportunities, and drive execution as Grüns continues to expand globally. You’ll be responsible for building durable analytics infrastructure, translating complex data into clear business insights, and driving high-impact decisions with a high level of autonomy. Location: While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Europe will be most successful in this role. More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL. In this role, you will: Own analytics for Grüns ’ international business, serving as a trusted partner to international leadership Identify business challenges and growth opportunities and leverage data to make strategic and tactical recommendations Apply structured problem-solving frameworks; develop hypotheses, tests, and analyses; lead implementation efforts; and establish monitoring plans Build, navigate, and manipulate large datasets using advanced SQL to answer ad hoc and strategic business questions Develop and maintain financial models to forecast the impact of new strategies, opportunities, and risks, and measure performance against expectations Design and maintain long-term BI dashboards to democratize access to international performance insights Translate complex analyses into clear, concise, executive-ready presentations that drive action Independently solve ambiguous, cross-functional problems end-to-end with minimal guidance We're looking for someone who: BS/MS degree in a quantitative or computational field 5+ years of experience in data analytics in corporate, consulting, or investment banking High proficiency with Excel High proficiency with PowerPoint Slides and Preparing Executive Decks High proficiency with SQL Fluency in English Experience with Looker Dashboards strongly preferred Knowledge of R, Python preferred Knowledge of presenting International numbers in the context of a US company going global Exceptional communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Strong thought partnership skills, with the ability to own senior stakeholder relationships through clarity, judgment, and follow-through A growth mindset, high ownership mentality, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, startup environmen Approach to the role: Operates with a growth mindset and treats ambiguity as normal, not a blocker Takes full ownership of outcomes without needing to be told what to do next Builds trust with senior stakeholders through clear thinking, not just clean output Moves fast without cutting corners on rigor Thrives in a startup environment where the job changes as the business does Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns , and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.description: Role Title: Subject Matter Expert – Chart & Data Visualization Analysis Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is selecting Subject Matter Experts – Chart & Data Visualization Analysis (AI Training) to contribute to a high-impact client project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for data-driven professionals with a meticulous eye for interpreting domain-specific charts, excellent quantitative reasoning, and a passion for communicating complex concepts clearly in both written and verbal form. Contributors from Medicine & Biostatistics, Finance & Economics, Engineering & Physics, Earth Sciences & GIS, Data Science & Statistics, or Operations & Manufacturing are especially encouraged to express interest. Scope of Work Interpret and analyze domain-specific charts, graphs, and data visualizations with a high level of accuracy and domain terminology precision. Design clear, unambiguous questions that require multi-step quantitative reasoning based on information-rich charts. Develop objectively answerable tasks focused on in-depth reasoning, calculations, comparisons, and trend analysis. Provide precise answers along with detailed, step-by-step explanations of your reasoning and calculation process. Utilize correct chart terms, units, axes, scales, legends, confidence intervals, and time periods in all tasks and solutions. Collaborate remotely with project coordinators and reviewers, demonstrating strong written and verbal communication skills. Ensure tasks are clear, free from subjectivity, and avoid unsupported conclusions or unnecessary complexity. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant domain (Medicine, Finance, Engineering, Earth Science, Data Science, Operations, etc.). At least two years of professional, academic, or research experience working with domain-relevant charts or quantitative data. Advanced degree, professional credential, or significant industry specialization (highly desirable). Demonstrated ability to select and interpret complex charts, including those with multiple data series, annotations, or statistical features. Experience authoring technical assessments, benchmark questions, or structured analytical tasks for learning, analytics, or evaluation purposes. Proven ability to write unambiguous, objectively answerable questions and communicate calculations clearly in English. Remote collaboration and asynchronous communication experience with cross-functional technical or research teams. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Principal Backend Engineer (Architect Track) - Remote
items.summary: Novakid is an online English platform for kids — 100,000+ students, 2,500+ teachers, 15+ countries.
items.description: Novakid is an online English platform for kids — 100,000+ students, 2,500+ teachers, 15+ countries. Live classes run around the clock across time zones, which sets the technical bar: low latency, high availability, and a backend that holds up at real scale. We’ve built a working platform. The next chapter is making deliberate architectural choices about how it should evolve. The role We’re hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to take ownership of backend architecture as a hands-on technical leader. No direct reports. About half your time is in the code — reference implementations, critical components, refactors. The other half is the harder work: deciding what to build, what to buy, what to defer, and why. Our backend today is a Python core (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Postgres, Redis), surrounded by services and event-driven flows, with a growing AI layer. It runs primarily on AWS, with GCP for data and AI workloads. There are real architectural questions to answer: how to evolve the monolith, how to set service boundaries, how to design for geo-distribution as we grow, and how to integrate AI without accumulating debt. We’re looking for someone who treats those questions seriously — researches before deciding, thinks in tradeoffs, writes things down.
