items.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time. The Opportunity: Grafana Observability builds end-to-end observability that spans application, infrastructure, database, browser, and mobile. Our Mobile Observability initiative gives mobile developers first-class instrumentation SDKs that capture traces, metrics, logs, crashes, and user sessions. Our solutions aim to be tightly integrated with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. We’re building high-performance, low-overhead SDKs that make it easy for teams to connect mobile signals to backend and infra telemetry for true full-stack visibility. We value open standards, great developer experience, and doing the hard engineering needed to ship reliable software at scale. You may not meet every requirement below. If this role excites you, please raise your hand. What You’ll Be Doing: Build and evolve mobile instrumentation SDKs for iOS (Swift / Obj-C), prioritizing performance, stability, and a great developer experience. Design and ship SDK features such as session tracking, crash reporting, sampling strategies, automatic context propagation, and OpenTelemetry integrations. Own projects end-to-end. Break large, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables: design modular solutions, ship MVPs, gather feedback, iterate quickly. Ensure quality: automated tests, CI, documentation, and smooth, backwards-compatible upgrade paths. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, frontend, product, and solutions engineering to ensure cohesive end-to-end observability workflows. Engage with the open-source community: review PRs, discuss design proposals, and help guide external contributors. Mentor teammates, participate in technical design discussions and help shape the mobile observability roadmap. What Makes You a Great Fit: You’re a motivated self-starter with a bias toward action and the ability to run with poorly defined scopes. You can operate autonomously while being highly collaborative. Strong mobile engineering experience: with iOS (Swift/Obj-C) and, optionally, Android (Kotlin/Java). Demonstrated experience building or maintaining mobile SDKs, platform libraries, or other developer-facing platform code used by external developers. Experience working with performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, network efficiency) and making pragmatic tradeoffs. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (instrumentation, SDKs, collectors) or experience contributing to/maintaining OTel SDKs or similar telemetry libraries. Excellent written and verbal communication. Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed team. Coachable, customer-focused, and passionate about developer experience, you can do more than code: you write docs, mentor others, and shape roadmaps. Pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity: you prioritize progress over perfection and iterate quickly based on feedback. Bonus Points For: Contributions to OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries, or other observability OSS. Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter) or building native bindings/bridges. Experience with mobile security, privacy, or platform integration challenges. Prior work on crash aggregation, session replay, or sampling for mobile telemetry. Compensation & Rewards: In UK, the compensation range for this role is £91,000 - £114,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs’ success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. #LI-Remote *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

items.title: Media Buyer FB
items.summary: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry.
items.description: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry. Founded in 2014, the company has been successfully operating on the market for more than 11 years, bringing together a team of 390+ professionals. Starting as a leader in the CIS region, the company is now actively expanding on a global scale. We are currently looking for a Middle/Senior Media Buyer to join the media buying team and work with scalable traffic across different GEOs and tiers. 📋 Key responsibilities and your contribution: Launch, manage, and scale Facebook advertising campaigns across Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3 GEOs. Full ownership of traffic performance and financial results, including PnL responsibility. Analyze and optimize key performance metrics: ROI, CR, CTR, CPM, CPA, PnL. Scale profitable campaigns without artificial budget caps. Work closely with offers, creatives, agencies, and internal teams to improve campaign efficiency. Test and adapt strategies based on changes in GEOs, offers, platforms, and market conditions. Identify bottlenecks in funnels and processes, propose and implement optimization solutions. Maintain clear communication, task-setting, and feedback loops within the team. 📚 Your qualifications: 2+ years of experience in media buying / traffic arbitrage. Deep understanding of Facebook Ads ecosystem and traffic acquisition mechanics. Proven experience managing monthly budgets from $50,000. Strong analytical mindset and confidence working with performance metrics and profitability models. Hands-on experience with analytics and tracking tools such as Power BI, Google Sheets, Voluum, Binom, Keitaro (or similar). Experience working with offers, creatives, and external partners (agencies, vendors). High level of responsibility for results and readiness to work with CRM and PnL models. Strong communication skills and ability to give and receive constructive feedback. Critical thinking, initiative, flexibility, and adaptability in a fast-changing environment. Benefits: ⭐ Time Off & Recovery: 20 working days of fully paid annual leave, fully paid sick leave, and public holidays off according to company policy. ⭐ Health & Wellness: A flexible Benefits cafeteria that allows you to choose the perks that fit you best, with options including medical support, regular check-ups, mental health services, or gym access. ⭐ Education & Development: Internal and external training, industry events, language courses, and professional service subscriptions. ⭐ Workspace & Tech: All necessary corporate equipment provided, the flexibility to work fully remotely, and premium digital tools to enhance performance (e.g., AI tools, ChatGPT Plus). ⭐ Work Environment & Perks: Holiday bonuses, gifts for special occasions, paid business trips, and team events. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: 1224SA - 377TEL | Project Accounting Specialist
items.summary: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years.
items.description: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years. We are a growing, privately held company looking for a dedicated Project Accounting Specialist to join our team. If you’re a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in collaborative environments, loves improving processes, and is passionate about achieving financial goals, this opportunity is for you! Position Overview: As a Project Accounting Specialist , you will play a critical role in managing project finances, ensuring accuracy in billing and reporting, and supporting internal teams and external clients. This role is integral to Telaid’s commitment to reducing the time, task, risk, and cost of technology deployments. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with Project Managers to gather timely and accurate information for monthly billings. Input project budgets and billing information into financial systems proactively. Generate invoices using various software and resolve billing-related issues with customers. Apply payments to customer accounts and reconcile discrepancies. Review credit reports for new customers to establish credit limits. Prepare periodic reports using accounting software. Participate in regular project review meetings to analyze financial performance and trends. Research and respond to inquiries from the Project Management Team regarding project costs and revenues. Develop project financial templates and support client onboarding to ensure smooth submission processes. Perform client submission verifications and address issues related to aging balances, escalating when necessary. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve billing and account-related discrepancies. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). Minimum of 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Experience with Crystal Reports and Microsoft Power BI is a plus. Familiarity with ERP systems and project accounting environments is desirable. Why Join Telaid? Be part of a company that values collaboration, innovation, and process improvement. Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while contributing to impactful technology deployment projects. Work with a supportive team and develop your skills in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment. If you’re ready to make a difference and grow your career with Telaid, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today to join our mission of delivering excellence in technology deployments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry, with its own affiliate program and in-house products in online casino, betting, and poker. The company has been successfully operating for more than 12 years, building strong positions in the CIS market while continuing global growth and expansion. We are currently looking for an Media Buyer TG. 📋 Key responsibilities and your contribution: Build and develop the Telegram Ads traffic source from scratch; Launch, test, optimize, and scale profitable advertising campaigns; Research and validate new approaches, creatives, funnels, and traffic strategies; Analyze campaign performance and continuously improve key metrics; Work closely with product, analytics, design, and marketing teams; Manage advertising budgets efficiently while maintaining profitability; Build a knowledge base of successful approaches and continuously optimize workflows; Monitor Telegram Ads updates, market trends, and competitor activities; Play a key role in growing the new direction with the opportunity to become a Team Lead as the team expands. 📚 Your qualifications: 3+ years of experience in media buying, including at least 1 year of hands-on experience with Telegram Ads; Proven experience in Gambling/iGaming traffic acquisition; Strong understanding of the Telegram Ads ecosystem, traffic sources, and campaign optimization; Experience launching, testing, and scaling campaigns from scratch; Ability to analyze key performance metrics (ROI, CPA, CR, CTR, CPM, PnL) and make data-driven decisions; Experience working with analytics and tracking tools (Keitaro, Binom, Voluum, Google Sheets, Power BI, etc.); Experience managing monthly advertising budgets starting from $50K; Understanding of affiliate offers, agency accounts, and Telegram Ads infrastructure; Strong analytical mindset and willingness to experiment with new approaches; Ability to work independently, take ownership, and build processes from the ground up. ➕ Nice to have: Experience working with CIS GEOs; Experience building Telegram funnels using bots, mini apps, or custom landing flows; Existing contacts with Telegram Ads agencies or account providers; Experience working with both product and affiliate traffic; Knowledge of automation tools, scripts, or AI solutions for campaign optimization; Experience mentoring teammates or leading traffic initiatives. Benefits: ⭐ Time Off & Recovery: 20 working days of fully paid annual leave, fully paid sick leave, and public holidays off according to company policy. ⭐ Health & Wellness: A flexible Benefits cafeteria that allows you to choose the perks that fit you best, with options including medical support, regular check-ups, mental health services, or gym access. ⭐ Education & Development: Internal and external training, industry events, language courses, and professional service subscriptions. ⭐ Workspace & Tech: All necessary corporate equipment provided, the flexibility to work fully remotely, and premium digital tools to enhance performance (e.g., AI tools, ChatGPT Plus). ⭐ Work Environment & Perks: Holiday bonuses, gifts for special occasions, paid business trips, and team events. items.title: STAQ Director
items.summary: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future.
items.description: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew! Position Objective The Director, STAQ leads the team responsible for EQT’s Special Project Case (SPC) pipeline — the “Innovation Engine” that turns business ideas into delivered technology and process improvements. The role owns intake, prioritization, scoping, solution-architecture governance, and value realization across a portfolio that serves every EQT business department. The ideal candidate is a delivery-minded leader who is comfortable with technical projects and oil & gas business applications, sets clear priorities against finite capacity, and builds a high-performing team and a culture of continuous improvement. Essential Duties Strategy & portfolio: Develop and maintain the STAQ strategy — project prioritization frameworks, value-realization tracking, and portfolio management — so EQT focuses on its highest-value initiatives. Pipeline ownership: Own the SPC pipeline end to end — intake, triage, scoping, prioritization, development hand-off to IT delivery teams, documentation, and post-implementation lookback. Cross-functional governance: Lead recurring cross-functional Special Project Reviews with business departments and internal team standups and architecture-collaboration sessions to align priorities and unblock delivery. Architecture & quality: Govern solution architecture and data-quality standards so the pipeline stays reliable, fast, supported, valuable, and clean (the Innovation Engine scorecard). People leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the STAQ team (Business Process Operations Manager and Business Process Engineers); foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Budget & capacity: Develop and manage the STAQ budget and capacity plan; balance incoming demand against the standing backlog and available staffing. Stakeholder alignment: Communicate with executive and cross-functional stakeholders to align department portfolios, delivery priorities, and enterprise strategy; steward STAQ’s knowledge base and operating standards. Continuous improvement: Research and evaluate emerging technologies (automation, analytics) for business applicability and pursue continuous improvement of the pipeline and its supporting infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of combined experience in technology delivery, business operations, and/or process improvement, including team leadership Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer/Data Science, Information Systems, or Business). An engineering degree is beneficial but not required. Experience delivering technology programs or products from inception through delivery to post-launch. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, define project scope, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Demonstrated understanding of data structures, analytics, and solution architecture (conceptual fluency required; hands-on engineering not required). Proven ability to coordinate, organize, lead, and develop teams, and to manage competing priorities across many stakeholders. Comfort working on technical projects and with oil & gas business applications, with a strong understanding of how the business works. Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or leading Salesforce-based business processes and custom solutions. Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks). Engineering and/or operational experience in the oil & gas industry (beneficial, not required). Experience leading a portfolio, delivery, or business-process function. Familiarity with EQT’s “Way We Work” operating model (Programs, Utilities, Insights, Sessions, and Knowledge). Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Software Engineering Company Description A Experian é uma empresa global de dados e tecnologia que impulsiona oportunidades para pessoas e empresas ao redor do mundo. Atuamos em diversos mercados, como serviços financeiros, saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros, entre outros. A Experian investe em pessoas e em novas tecnologias avançadas para liberar o poder dos dados. Contamos com uma equipe incrível de 25.200 colaboradores em 32 países. Nossa singularidade é valorizar a sua. A cultura da Experian, centrada nas pessoas, inclusiva e orientada por propósito, é reconhecida por diversos prêmios - incluindo World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Top 25 global da Fortune) e Great Place To Work™ em 26 países, entre outros. Confira o Experian Life nas redes sociais ou explore nosso site de carreiras para entender o porquê. A Experian também se orgulha de ser uma empregadora que promove igualdade de oportunidades e ação afirmativa. Description Product Owner - Finance Systems & Projects Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar como elo entre as áreas de Finanças e Tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas financeiros da organização. Este profissional será responsável por liderar a gestão de demandas, incidentes e melhorias sistêmicas, assegurando rápida resposta às necessidades do negócio, além de atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de transformação e automação de processos financeiros. A posição exige forte interação com stakeholders de diversas áreas de finanças, capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos e habilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas eficientes. Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Gerenciar e priorizar demandas, incidentes e problemas críticos, assegurando tratamento adequado dentro dos SLAs definidos. Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências. Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação. Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais. Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas. Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas. Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia. Gestão de Projetos Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras. Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas. Qualifications Conhecimento dos principais processos financeiros, incluindo: Contratação e Faturamento (Billing) Contas a Receber (Accounts Receivable) Revenue Recognition Cobrança e aplicações de recebimentos Controles financeiros e contábeis Inglês avançado obrigatório Sistemas e Ferramentas Gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares) Ferramentas de documentação (Confluence ou similares) Power BI e IA (desejável) Experiência com ERP, sistemas financeiros e integrações Metodologias Agile / Scrum Kanban Gestão de Projetos Competências Comportamentais Comunicação clara e objetiva Forte capacidade de priorização Senso de urgência Organização e gestão simultânea de múltiplas demandas Perfil colaborativo e orientado ao cliente interno Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders Visão de processos e resolução de problemas Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com constante mudança de prioridades Diferenciais Experiência prévia em áreas de Finance Systems, Finance Transformation ou Product Ownership em Finanças. Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R. Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas. Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros. Additional Information Esta é uma posição exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, aqui na Serasa temos diversas iniciativas, como por exemplo: intérpretes de libras, tecnologias assistivas, cordão girassol (deficiências ocultas), entre outras ações. Na Serasa Experian temos o grupo Aspire que visa construir para um ambiente acessível e de oportunidades justas para os profissionais com deficiência. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação! You’ll thrive in a collaborative, globally distributed team and contribute to work that’s not only creatively exciting but also strategically sharp. This is a role for someone who can think big, execute beautifully, and bring a deep understanding of design to everything they do.

items.title: Conceptual Copywriter
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Copywriter to ideate and execute impactful creative work across digital campaigns and marketing channels. In this role, you’ll partner with designers, strategists, and performance teams to develop concept-driven copy that delivers both creative impact and measurable results. You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms.

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.description: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. DataGrail is shipping innovative products faster than ever before to meet our customers' needs and outpace the competition. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you’ll build the launch and enablement engine that turns that product velocity into customer adoption and revenue. You’ll ensure every release reaches the right audience, equip our GTM teams to confidently communicate the value of new capabilities, and help customers understand how the DataGrail platform solves their most important privacy challenges. This is a foundational, high-impact role. The systems, enablement programs, and AI-powered workflows you build during your first six months will shape how DataGrail brings new capabilities to market, helping accelerate adoption, support revenue growth and set the business up for long-term success. What You'll Do Design and own a continuous launch program that scales with our release process Deliver field enablement that instills confidence and empowers customer-facing teams to effectively position new capabilities and win deals Own competitive and voice-of-customer intelligence, turning it into messaging, battlecards, and playbooks that convert our target buyer Use AI to build a repeatable product content workflow, producing consistent, high-performing product content across formats and channels Take full, end-to-end ownership of Tier 1 launches, including strategy, cross-functional coordination, execution, and measurement Partner across Growth, Product, Sales, and CS to build consensus and drive shared outcomes. What You'll Bring 3–5 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS A track record of building (not just running) launch programs from scratch Strong positioning and product content instincts, ability to produce high-performing product content across formats and channels Expertise in using AI tools to build innovative, efficient solutions to complex challenges Strong project management skills, you’ve run multi-stage, multi-stakeholder initiatives with true ownership An understanding of what Sales and Customer Success teams need to effectively position, sell, and support new products Technical aptitude to understand complex concepts and translate them to compelling stories Bonus Points Experience in privacy, security, or another trust-driven B2B category with complex competitive dynamics Experience owning competitive intelligence programs that directly informed product roadmap decisions A history of building AI-driven workflows that improve how teams work, not just your own personal productivity What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days You'll: Adopt the existing launch tiering framework Become an SME on our story, positioning, ICP, and personas Identify gaps in current systems for a continuous-shipping world Build a roadmap to refine tiering and launch process to match shipping pace Establish release tracking with the product team Within 180 Days You'll: Build an AI framework for structure and speed at continuous-shipping pace Stand up a repeatable process for collateral and field-facing docs Run point on all tier 2 and tier 3 launches Launch and adoption KPI dashboards live Establish a field feedback loop with GTM teams Within 365 Days You'll: Full launch and enablement system live, powered by the AI framework At least one tier 1 launch owned end-to-end Recognized as a key partner to product and GTM teams Messaging framework refined based on customer feedback, new products, and market shifts Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state. All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $150,000—$170,000 USD About Us: DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Bloomreach builds agentic AI systems for our customers. We also run them ourselves. Our AI SDR program books sales meetings with AI - inbound and outbound, across four regions, in multiple languages. The program needs an owner: someone who sets its direction, drives its results, and proves its ROI. This is a program leadership role, not an engineering one. Two dedicated AI ops experts build and run the platform. You decide what it does, why, and for whom. You should understand AI agents well enough to direct the people building them - your leverage is judgment, but being tech savvy is a must. The team experiments by default: we test new AI tools, run scoped POCs, and keep what works. You'll own the program, its direction, its results, its pipeline number. What you'll own The AI SDR program, end to end. Inbound and outbound, AMER + EMEA + APAC. Who gets enrolled, what the agents say, when a human takes over, and what it produces in pipeline. You set direction; the platform ops managers make it run. (Inbound request ops and routing sit with a colleague.) Pipeline as your number, ROI as your story. Meetings booked → accepted → qualified pipeline created. Cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar. You report the program's return to leadership, with numbers that hold up under questioning. The human SDR side. SDRs are the other half of the program - and where it most often breaks: lead quality disputes, unclear prioritization, follow-up that dies after one touch, handovers that lose context. You'll sit with the SDR teams and their leaders, find root causes, and fix them - with an AI assist, a process change, or a better definition. The human–agent split. What agents do, what humans do, and where the handover sits. You own that line and move it based on evidence. Signal-driven enrollment. Targeting runs on manual batches today. You'll drive the move to continuous enrollment based on account scoring, intent signals, and engagement decay. You define the logic; the ops team builds it. The buying experience. Outreach should arrive because an account signalled something, say something true about the buyer's business, and make the next step obvious. Program reporting. Volume, coverage, results, and ROI on a live dashboard, generated automatically. Parts still run on exports. Fix that early. What comes next. The AI SDR pattern - signal in, agent acts, human closes - applies beyond outbound: event follow-up, hand-raiser nurture, re-engagement. Once the core program runs well, you'll make the case for the next one and drive its launch. What success looks like after 3 months Outbound volume and coverage are consistent across regions. Nobody asks "why did outbound drop last week?" Leadership references your ROI model in planning: cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar, trend. The top three SDR pain points from your first quarter are root-caused and fixed - and SDR leaders would confirm it unprompted. Meeting acceptance is high. Rejections have known causes, not theories. Reporting is fully automated. Your time goes into decisions. The program activities and volume is connected to human activities, pipeline number for ICP accounts is bigger - and you can show which changes drove it. At least one new agentic program is live and producing pipeline. What you'll bring You've run programs with a number attached. Demand gen, SDR/BDR, growth, or GTM programs where you owned the outcome and defended the metric. You've operated AI workflows in production. You've deployed, directed, or owned automations other people depended on. You can set requirements, challenge the build, and tell when the agent is the problem versus the data. You don't need to write code - you do need to never be bluffed by it. ROI fluency. You can build a cost-per-outcome model and explain it. You'd rather show a live dashboard than a slide. You diagnose team problems at the source. "The leads are bad" is where your investigation starts, not where it ends. You've worked with frontline teams, found the real constraint, and fixed it. SDRs, AEs, and their leaders are your users. When the program misfires, you’ll be their point of contact. The buyer's point of view. Buyers don't care that outreach was efficient - only that it was worth their time. You'll kill a volume that doesn't clear that bar. Enough technical depth to be dangerous. You can read a workflow, question a data model, and learn a new tool in a week. Experience with our stack is welcome, not required. Global comfort. Four regions, several languages, overlap with US hours. Big Advantage:: hands-on LLM tooling beyond vendor UIs (Claude Code, MCP, custom agents); time in or working with SDR/BDR and demand gen function in B2B SaaS. The stack you'll drive Salesforce · Qualified · Salesloft · UserGems · Claude - plus a mandate to evaluate AI-native tooling with a clear bar for measurable impact. The team You'll join Marketing Operations six people who operationalize and automate everything in marketing. Two of them work full-time on the AI SDR platform: they build and run it; you set its direction and co-own it: reporting and attribution, co-own and maintain inbound/outbound processes and find new tools. It's a team that builds its own tools rather than filing tickets for them. More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization.
 

This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany. 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC
  • AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana
  • Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands.
  • Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team.
  • Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris.
  • Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets.
  • Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them.
  • Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance.
  • Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects.
  • Strong development skills in Java and C++.
  • Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats.
  • Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions.
  • Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better.

Bonus Skills

  • Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines.

#LI-IM1
#LI-REMOTE

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.     

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies. By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match. items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. items.description: About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what’s next. For more than a decade we’ve helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we’re scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: We’re looking for a Senior Finance Manager, Sales to join our Finance team. You will be a key partner to Sales and RevOps leadership, helping shape metrics-driven decision making across Sales budget and headcount, commissions, SLG bookings, quota planning, capacity, and productivity. This role will have high cross-functional visibility and will be central to building the financial discipline, operating cadence, and scalable reporting needed to support Vercel’s next stage of growth. What You Will Do: Serve as the trusted Finance partner for the CRO by delivering actionable insights through forecasting, scenario analysis, business reviews, and resource allocation recommendations Own Sales budget and headcount planning, including bottoms-up workforce models that connect hiring plans, ramp timing, productivity assumptions, commissions, and compensation costs to bookings and revenue goals Support SLG bookings and quota planning by partnering with Sales and RevOps on quota capacity, ramp, attainment, coverage, territory design inputs, and productivity assumptions Support commissions planning, forecasting, and reporting in partnership with Accounting, RevOps, and Sales leadership, including commission expense, accruals, plan changes, and performance insights Lead Sales BvA reviews and operating cadences, translating financial results into clear variance narratives, risks, opportunities, and recommendations Improve Sales Finance reporting and tooling by building scalable dashboards, templates, and processes that reduce manual work, improve forecast accuracy, and surface key risks earlier About You: Commercially sharp and analytically rigorous – You understand how Sales and RevOps teams operate and can connect SLG bookings, quota planning, pipeline, capacity, attainment, productivity, commissions, headcount, and spend to the company’s financial plan. Anti-bureaucracy, pro-speed – You streamline workflows, remove drag, and make decisions with clarity. You believe a 3-bullet Slack post with a clear recommendation is better than a 20-slide deck. Tech-forward operator – You go beyond Excel. You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to automate, clean, and generate insights. You treat Finance like a product—always shipping improvements. Detail-obsessed – You know that a single error in quota capacity, ramp timing, commission logic, or start dates can swing the forecast by millions. You sweat the details so the CFO and Sales leaders don’t have to. Strong cross-functional partner – You can build trust with Sales leadership while maintaining financial discipline, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and driving decisions with data. Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $200,000.00-$240,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don’t necessarily check every box on the job description.
